chief_decision: Manual tri-star hand truck v4 with one-piece twin-tube 40 by 36 mm backbone, strap, paired-wheel roll, tri-star climb, dead-man disc plus tooth lock, folding toe plus sliding handle with clip-on brace alongside. Total 67.1 kg for 658 N lifted, 129 J per riser, slope 403 N held by 74.6 N m total 37.3 N m per side with 57.4 N release, backbone 40.9 MPa with impact at 118 N m unified offset with 43.9 mm whip, folded 1145 by 380 by 190 mm entering on 1670 mm diagonal to 1802 mm floor with 69.7 N tare lift. Bench tests named: lever release feel and tooth engagement wear after build.
